summary: Tested bug fix: stok tidak berkurang saat dijual. Backend + Frontend both work correctly. UI updates stock without manual reload after Jual/Tambah Stok. Delete nota restores stock. Low-stock banner shows correctly. All 3 backend pytest cases and 4 frontend UI checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_sale uses count_documents+1 as nota sequence — race condition possible on concurrent sales, could produce duplicate nota_no. Consider atomic counter/collection.
create_sale $inc stok can push stock negative — no validation to reject sale when qty > available stok. Consider guardrail.
delete_sale silently returns 200 even when sid not found; no 404.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UIStok & TEST_LowStok products during test; both cleaned up. Sales created were deleted (via UI + API). No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 'stok tidak berkurang saat dijual' verified fixed. Fix: confirmJual() and confirmTambahStok() in HPPKalkulator.jsx call await refresh() which reloads products from backend, refreshing UI stok values. Backend was already correct (POST /api/sales $inc stok -qty; DELETE /api/sales $inc stok +qty).
rca of the issue: RCA: Backend already decremented stok correctly on POST /api/sales. UI (HPPKalkulator) was displaying stale local rows state after createSale, never refetching. Fix: await refresh() after createSale/updateProduct so table's Stok inputs reflect DB. Confirmed by e2e Playwright: created product stok=10, sold qty=3 → UI shows 7 without manual reload; +5 via Tambah Stok → 12; delete nota (via API) → restored to 15.
